goal: Add human-gated live prompt promotion and bounded Dream-RSI-style exploration-policy replay.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Online live search persists a fixed-policy parent-linked discovery tree and validates its recorded batch decisions.
Dream replay uses compatible fully recorded trees and stored prefix outcomes without model, evaluator, native-host, or pointer activity.
An exact current human decision gates pointer activation, failed canaries compensate, and recovery does not bypass authorization.
Schemas, focused contracts, capsules, documentation, and regression coverage describe the staged promotion and replay boundaries.
The package and clean-consumer smoke checks retain executable CLI, schema, template, plugin-import, and replay behavior.

outcome.summary: The bounded local contracts, implementation, tests, capsule refresh, and package verification completed without a new native campaign.

what_worked: A shared root-or-leaf batch interface preserves prefix-only replay semantics.
Separating review staging from pointer writes keeps dashboard and replay outputs non-authorizing.
Focused recovery tests exposed and closed pointer, approval, and legacy-state edge cases before the repository gate.
what_failed: The first repository gate exposed a capsule test date that predated the refreshed capsule review date; the deterministic test pin was updated and the full gate passed on rerun.

calls.name: vitest-live-loop
calls.purpose: Verify discovery, replay, promotion, rollback, dashboard, recovery, and compatibility behavior with synthetic transport.

calls.name: capsule-check
calls.purpose: Validate refreshed contract capsules against their pinned local sources.

calls.name: repository-check
calls.purpose: Run type, build, test, capsule, policy, scorecard, and benchmark verification.

calls.name: release-smoke
calls.purpose: Pack repository artifacts and verify a clean consumer without native mounting or a model call.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: The refreshed capsule review date required updating the deterministic capsule-test clock.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Keep capsule test time at or after any intentional checked_at refresh.

evidence.summary: Focused live-loop and CLI verification passed 31 tests with synthetic transport.
All committed capsules validated against current pinned sources.
Repository verification passed 1,248 tests with seven opt-in skips plus required policy and scorecard checks.
Eight package artifacts and clean-consumer smoke verification passed without native mounting or a model call.

uncertainty.statement: No new native campaign or external-service execution occurred; evidence is local implementation and synthetic transport verification only.
uncertainty.resolution: Run a separately approved exact live campaign before claiming native-service proof.

uncertainty.statement: The bounded declarative policy family is not evidence of general model-developed exploration policies or cross-workspace policy gains.
uncertainty.resolution: Evaluate pre-registered policy baselines across independently approved compatible campaign worlds.

notes: No live promotion, native campaign, shared-profile change, plugin mount, or external transfer occurred during this change.
